I have launched the existing `model_fields.test_jsonfield` test suite in the task container and will inspect the results once it finishes.
I have resolved the issue in [json.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_q8yqmly/django/db/models/fields/json.py):

- Added [`HasKeyLookup.compile_json_path_final_key`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_q8yqmly/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L175-L177) and updated [`HasKeyLookup.as_sql`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_q8yqmly/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L179-L207) so that the final key in `has_key`, `has_keys`, and `has_any_keys` lookups is always compiled as a JSON object key (`.%s` with `json.dumps(...)`) rather than an array index when the key is numeric.
- Added [`HasKeyOrArrayIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_q8yqmly/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L257-L259) and used it in [`KeyTransformIsNull`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_q8yqmly/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L393-L415) and [`KeyTransformExact`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-_q8yqmly/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L446-L484) so that `isnull` and `exact=None` lookups on `KeyTransform` continue to treat integer transforms as array indices.
